name: qa-virtual-office
description: Claude Code QA Virtual Office - local-first QA command center

scripts.build: npm run build:forwarder && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @qavo/server
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo -w @qavo/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/forwarder && tsc -p apps/mcp && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/desktop
scripts.hooks:install: npm run build:forwarder && tsx apps/server/src/cli/hooks.ts install
scripts.statusline:install: npm run build:forwarder && tsx apps/server/src/cli/hooks.ts statusline-install
scripts.desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build:forwarder && node apps/desktop/start.mjs
